finding: /{id} endpoints (PATCH /books/{id}, approve/decline, loan reads) do not enforce object ownership in the contract
mitigation: Scope every query to caller sub; return 404 for non-owned resources; add per-endpoint authz test

finding: Write endpoints (POST /books, POST /borrow-requests, :send-now) declare 429 but no rate-limit rule is configured
mitigation: Front Door rate limiting: 100/min per IP on writes, tighter on :send-now

finding: Member email/apartment could be returned for other members, or leak into App Insights logs/traces
mitigation: Return PII only for /members/me; redact Authorization + PII before logging; log member ID not email

finding: Free-text q on GET /books flows into a query; confirm parameterised, not concatenated
mitigation: Parameterise/bind q; CI lint against raw SQL string concat

finding: Token lifetime and JWKS signature/iss/aud/exp validation asserted in design but not proven by a test
mitigation: Add CI test rejecting none-alg and expired tokens with 401

finding: HTTPS-only, min TLS 1.2, and HSTS not confirmed at Front Door
mitigation: Enable HTTPS-only redirect, min TLS 1.2, add HSTS header

finding: Verify no plaintext connection strings in App Service settings
mitigation: Use Key Vault references; assert no secrets in app settings

finding: Baseline scan flags missing X-Content-Type-Options / CSP / HSTS on responses
mitigation: Add security headers at Azure Front Door
